title: Storyboard and animatic for a 12-second promo
caption: Before anything is rendered: mgvideo plan turns a 12-second Magnifito brief and its claims register into a timed three-scene plan, mgvideo storyboard draws one styleframe per scene and a review contact sheet, and mgvideo montage holds each frame for its planned length to make an animatic with a slate per shot (scene, beat, recipe, length, linked claim) and a progress bar.
prompt: Use the magnifito-storyboard skill to plan a 12-second 16:9 promo for Magnifito from brief.json, brand.json and claims.json, before we render anything. Make the claims-linked scene plan, a storyboard with one styleframe per scene and a contact sheet I can send to the client, and an animatic that holds each frame for exactly its planned length. Mark each shot with a slate (scene number, beat, recipe and length) in Geist from fonts/, a progress bar with a tick at each cut, and put a soft whoosh on each cut and a chime on the last card so the timing can be judged with sound.
commands: node stage.mjs work/board brief.json brand.json claims.json

ffmpeg -i work/shot-1.mp4 -i work/shot-2.mp4 -i work/shot-3.mp4 -i work/whoosh.wav -i work/chime.wav -i work/slate-1.png -i work/slate-2.png -i work/slate-3.png -f lavfi -i color=c=0x8acf31:s=1920x6:r=30:d=12 -filter_complex "[0:v][1:v][2:v]concat=n=3:v=1:a=0[c];[c][5:v]overlay=0:0:enable='lt(t,3.2)'[s1];[s1][6:v]overlay=0:0:enable='between(t,3.2,8)'[s2];[s2][7:v]overlay=0:0:enable='gte(t,8)'[s3];[s3][8:v]overlay=x='-1920+1920*t/12':y=988,format=yuv420p[v];[3]asplit=2[w0][w1];[w0]adelay=3050:all=1,volume=0.5[x0];[w1]adelay=7850:all=1,volume=0.5[x1];[4]adelay=8300:all=1,volume=0.6[x2];[x0][x1][x2]amix=inputs=3:normalize=0,aformat=sample_rates=48000:channel_layouts=stereo,apad,atrim=0:12,afade=t=out:st=11.2:d=0.8[a]" -map [v] -map [a] -t 12 -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 160k work/animatic.mp4
